mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.model, m.install_date AS installDate, m.verification_cycle AS verificationCycle, m.meter_status AS meterStatus, m.install_location AS installLocation, m.bind_date AS bindDate, m.ratio, m.customer_id AS customerId, c.customer_name AS customerName, c.electricity_category AS electricityCategory, c.address, c.contact FROM smart_meter m LEFT JOIN electricity_customer c ON m.customer_id = c.id WHERE m.id = #{id} AND m.deleted = 0

SELECT m.id, m.model, m.install_date AS installDate, m.verification_cycle AS verificationCycle, m.meter_status AS meterStatus, m.install_location AS installLocation, m.bind_date AS bindDate, m.ratio, m.customer_id AS customerId, c.customer_name AS customerName FROM smart_meter m LEFT JOIN electricity_customer c ON m.customer_id = c.id
m.deleted = 0
AND m.model LIKE CONCAT('%', #{model}, '%')
AND m.meter_status = #{meterStatus}
AND m.customer_id = #{customerId}
AND m.install_location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{installLocation}, '%')
ORDER BY m.create_time ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalMeters, SUM(CASE WHEN meter_status = '正常' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normal, SUM(CASE WHEN meter_status = '故障' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS faulty, SUM(CASE WHEN meter_status = '待检定' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingVerification FROM smart_meter WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT model, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN meter_status = '正常' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN meter_status = '故障' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS faultyCount FROM smart_meter WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY model ORDER BY total ASC
